name: What should I look for when hiring a contractor for a shower or tub upgrade in the East Bay?
description: Hire a licensed, insured contractor with good reviews, a clear contract, warranty, and local experience.

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when hiring a contractor for a shower or tub upgrade in the East Bay?

acceptedAnswer.text: When hiring a contractor for a shower or tub upgrade in the East Bay, look for a licensed and insured company with a proven track record. Check their portfolio, read customer reviews, and ensure they provide a detailed contract and warranty. Local experience in areas like Berkeley or Oakland is also beneficial.
